title: Hanasato Minori — Sharing My Honest Feelings〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Now that Minori's here, let's get started, shall we?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Then, let's start checking over everything we'll be taking to the Lumina Grand Prix!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Still, this is a lot of luggage...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <But we're going to need all these things since the prelim stage is a training camp that takes place over a month.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <So, let's make sure we aren't forgetting anything!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <First, cosmetics, since they're so essential to idols. Do you all have your makeup kits and care products packed?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Yup! I've got my makeup, lotion, cleanser and... That's everything!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <We should also take shampoo and body wash that suits each of us best, yes?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Oh, good point. It'd be smart to pour some into smaller containers to bring.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <We agreed to split up our streaming gear, right?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Yeah, hopefully we can set aside some time during the prelim stage to interact with our fans.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <We still haven't been told all the little rules, but I feel that we should take some stuff just in case.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<But we can't exactly take anything big.
We'll have to limit ourselves to selfie sticks, smartphone stands, tripods and small lights.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Yeah. All that's left is for each of us to pack anything we need individually.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Oh, I know... I'll take those with me!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
<These new pajamas I got.
They're so cute because they're covered with art of otters!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Otters...? Like the one that's on the T-shirt you wear whenever we practice?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Yeah! I want everyone watching the show to see them.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <But there aren't any cameras in the bedrooms!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Hehe. It looks like your otter pajamas are going to be a special treat that only we get to enjoy.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
<What else is there...? Oh, that's right!
I need to take a picture of Samo with me!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Because I probably won't get to see him much during the training camp. I thought I could look at it whenever I'm feeling lonely.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <I think I'll put it in a frame and place it in our room.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <A part of me feels like you're going overboard, but I also understand what you mean...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
<That just leaves my favorite cushion...
Oh, I should also take my bunny plushie with me!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <No, you absolutely do not need to bring those!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <If you start packing every little thing, your luggage is gonna turn into a huge mess.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Not only are we going somewhere we've never been before, we're gonna be there for a whole month.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <So, I feel like I should bring what I can to help me stay in my regular groove.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Things that help cheer me up or settle my nerves and stuff...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Yes, it is always nice to have things that are close to your heart.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I agree...
Creating the optimal environment for yourself is pretty important.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <But you can't take everything, got it?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <I think I'll take a penguin plushie with me as a sort of lucky charm...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <In that case, I think I'll take some of my favorite cat merch.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
<Then, I'll bring a picture of Shii.
We can have her sit next to Samo.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
<Oh, that's a great idea!
Our room's feeling warm and cozy already!>
